summary: The failures point to two formatting behaviors in the range/tuple formatter: map formatting omits its outer braces, while `{:n}` tuple formatting still inserts the default comma-space separator. The supplied excerpts show tuple parsing and separator state, but omit the formatter bodies and current range-formatting implementation needed to identify the cause and boundaries.
hypotheses: Map formatting selects an unbracketed path for both standard map entries and entries with a custom pair formatter.
Tuple parsing of `n` fails to clear or honor the default separator, so tuple elements remain comma-space separated.
